name: Proto (mask prototype network)

whatIsIt.eli5: Makes a set of shape pictures that all objects share.
whatIsIt.simple: A small network on the most detailed neck map that outputs 32 prototype masks at twice that map's resolution.

whyExists.eli5: Shared shapes are cheaper than drawing each object's shape from zero.
whyExists.simple: Masks need fine detail, so prototypes are made from the P3 map and upsampled once more (stride 4).
whyExists.engineer: Shared basis for linear mask assembly; transposed conv learns the ×2 upsampling.

simple: Transposed conv doubles height and width.
